title: Raw results route reports Windows transient access-denied/sharing errors during the launcher's atomic replace as permanent 500
outcome: A transient Windows open failure (ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED delete-pending or a sharing violation, raw OS 32/33) on results.json during a live run is classified as retryable (e.g. 409 test_run_results_changed), consistent with test_run_read_json, or the 500 is documented as possibly transient.
acceptance: Raw results route reports Windows transient access-denied/sharing errors during the launcher's atomic replace as permanent 500 is done
